messages:
Anika (AE): quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Anika (AE): HelixCare: advanced eval done, wants on-prem packaging + KMS integration. blocker: timelines for on-prem distro and HSM/KMS guidance.
Anika (AE): NovaGrid: legal asked for IP clause redline + SOC2 attestation copy.
Anika (AE): Portside Capital: POC live but latency issues during parallel requests — flagged to eng.
Maya (Sales Ops): FYI I uploaded HelixCare questionnaire to the drive: https://redwood.app/drive/helix-q1
Maya (Sales Ops): also synced CAP table for NovaGrid on the pipeline board.
Dan (RM): HelixCare — can we commit to a delivery quarter? customer pushing for Q2 private deployment.
Dan (RM): Portside — I saw the latency spike at 10:12am, looks like burst behavior on long contexts. logged incident with eng-runtime.
Ravi (Solutions): @Dan can you share a sample payload? small tweak might reduce KV cache pressure.
Dan (RM): sending sample now in thread.
Dan (RM): ```json
{"user_id":"portside-123","input":"<long doc...>","tokens":12000}
```
Liam (Security): quick answers: 1) SOC2 report — we have SSAE and SOC2 in the vendor pack, can share the latest PDF. 2) KMS/HSM — supported via customer-managed KMS in Private; HSM options in roadmap, need legal/contract approval for HSM integrations.
Sarah (Privacy): Data residency: for HelixCare they require EU-only. Private deployment plus region restriction works, but Ops will need lead time for infra.
Olga (Legal): For NovaGrid IP redline send me the clause they want changed. we can propose alternative language. also need to know if Portside requires indemnity changes.
Anika (AE): Action items I have: 1) collect SOC2 + KMS doc & share with HelixCare (Maya to attach) 2) get on-prem ETA from eng and SRE 3) email NovaGrid redline to Olga 4) track Portside latency with Ravi/eng
Maya (Sales Ops): attaching SOC2 link now (internal): https://redwood.app/docs/soc2.pdf
Ravi (Solutions): quick mitigation for Portside: try `max_response_tokens=2048` and reduce concurrent sessions per connection. If that helps we'll propose a batching config.
Dan (RM): noted, will trial the config and report back by EOD.
Liam (Security): for KMS questions, @Anika @Olga — what level of key custody do they need (we support customer-managed keys, not HSM-backed keys yet). If they insist on HSM we need to scope timeline.
Anika (AE): HelixCare wants full customer key custody (bring-your-own-KMS) plus audit logs.
Olga (Legal): can cover audit log SLA in contract addendum. I'll draft a short clause and share tomorrow.
Maya (Sales Ops): pipeline flags: HelixCare = compliance gating, NovaGrid = legal redline, Portside = perf risk. Prioritization?
Dan (RM): prioritize HelixCare then Portside then NovaGrid. HelixCare has the highest ARR potential.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll run a short perf test after Dan posts the exact payload, expect suggestions within 4 hours.
Liam (Security): I'll drop SOC2 artifact and a note about KMS limitations here by lunchtime.
ComplianceBot: automated reminder: submit compliance exception requests at least 10 business days before deployment. See /compliance-requests.
Anika (AE): Thanks team — who wants to own the HelixCare pre-deploy checklist? (docs, SOC2, KMS, network runbook)
Maya (Sales Ops): I can own the checklist and coordinate docs.
Olga (Legal): I'll take NovaGrid redline and draft HelixCare addendum language.
Dan (RM): I'll run the Portside perf trial and update.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll do the perf tuning and post results here.
Liam (Security): I'll confirm SOC2 artifact and write a short KMS note for Maya to pass to customer.
Anika (AE): Great — I'll close the loop with HelixCare after we have SOC2 + KMS note + ETA.
Maya (Sales Ops): small ask — can we get an engineering ETA for private package? a ballpark is fine for customer comms.
Ravi (Solutions): pinging @eng-runtime for ETA — if we can get a 2-4 week window that's doable for a minimal on-prem bundle, broader HSM work is months.
Anika (AE): perfect. that's it from me. ping here for updates. :thumbsup:
